digest.component_or_area: BindingStore lifecycle policy and repository mutations
propositions: BindingStore embeds forward/reverse identity transitions, pending/confirmed state, numeric-ID re-key, comment identity, absence grace, tombstones, and unretire policy that must be extracted into a cohesive lifecycle policy owner
Production rich-text convergence mutates the repository dictionary through shallow all_bindings() bypass, requiring a narrow facade operation as the supported mutation seam

At-most-one identity must be maintained through targeted single-key reverse pops in permitted cases: duplicate bind overwrites forward entry and pops old reverse key only when different, numeric-ID re-key substitutes instead of retiring, three confirmed 404s trigger retirement
Comment IDs remain append-only and change-gated; legacy entries without the field remain readable; tombstoned issues suppress recreate until explicit unretire
The narrow note_rich_emit() operation must preserve current counter/hash behavior and missing-binding fail-open result without changing all_bindings() copy depth
Existing facade signatures and shallow all_bindings() semantics remain unchanged; no adapter or reconciler caller receives writable repository object directly
